verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents letting your own system authorize and adjust transactions instead of its credit core or authorizer [pomelo-docs-18], with a stand-in fallback when your services respond slowly [pomelo-docs-7]. That approximates the 'my system approves each authorization' half of just-in-time funding. Digital accounts [pomelo-docs-17] and a credit core [pomelo-docs-6] hint at other models, but none is framed as a funding choice. Missing for 10: explicit prefunded-balance funding model, evidence that the external authorizer also funds each authorization, documentation of cash-flow tradeoffs between models, independent corroboration.
